description: Starfighter on the Karadeniz Teknik Üniversitesi campus in Trabzon, wearing the code 8-284. Construction number 683D-8284. The International F-104 Society records refurbishment in 2021. Confirmed present on Esri World Imagery examined September 2026, which resolves the airframe on the paved forecourt of the large campus building.
museum_name: Karadeniz Teknik Üniversitesi F-104 Monument -- Trabzon
